name: Koga Nao
source:
Nao's got a quirky personality and marches to the beat of his own drum. Chronic insomnia often leaves him with dark circles under his eyes and a perpetually sleepy look.

Thanks to a misunderstanding with [url=https://vndb.org/c101093]Kirame[/url], he ends up in a situation that looks suspiciously like a one-night stand. To make matters worse, his long-time crush, [url=https://vndb.org/c101092]Yua[/url], suddenly decides to respond to his confession, which he had left hanging for ages. Just like that, he's slapped with the title of a two-timing scoundrel.

Nao tries to roll with the punches, figuring what's done is done, but he has absolutely no idea what to do next.

[Translated from the [url=https://asa-pro.com/futakoi/chara/chara5.html]official website[/url]]
